verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs show extensive natural-language-driven operation: chat/agent mode plans and executes multi-step coding tasks, launches parallel agent 'fleets', sets up always-on agents via triggers, and integrates across terminal/Slack/GitHub—all driven by NL instructions rather than manual commands. Community evidence criticizes bugginess and competition but doesn't dispute that NL command-driven agentic workflows are core and functional.
